## cdhit evaluate thresholds
```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(magick)
library(fs)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# inputs
img_dir<-"../2026-07-01_g1_eval_out"
out_dir<-"plot_out"
dir_create(out_dir)

# helper: read TIFF/PNG/etc -> ggplot object (optional crop top & bottom)
img_to_gg<-function(img_path,crop_frac=0){
  img<-magick::image_read(img_path)
  info<-magick::image_info(img)
  w<-info$width[1]
  h<-info$height[1]

  if(!is.null(crop_frac) && crop_frac>0){
    crop_px<-round(h*crop_frac)
    new_h<-h-(2*crop_px)
    geom<-paste0(w,"x",new_h,"+0+",crop_px)
    img<-magick::image_crop(img,geom)
  }

  ggdraw()+draw_image(as.raster(img),x=0,y=0,width=1,height=1)+theme_void()
}

# fixed filenames (in order A-D)
expected_files<-function(){
  c("percentID_vs_Ncluster.nosing.tiff",
    "percentID_vs_Nsingle.tiff",
    "percentID_vs_maxsize.tiff",
    "percentID_vs_meansize.nosing.tiff")
}

# build 2x2 grid + save
save_grid_2x2<-function(img_dir,out_dir,
                        width=8,height=8,dpi=300,
                        out_name="cdhit_eval_composite.png"){

  wanted<-expected_files()
  paths<-path(img_dir,wanted)

  missing<-wanted[!file_exists(paths)]
  if(length(missing)>0){
    message("Missing: ",paste(missing,collapse=", "))
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  plots<-map(paths,img_to_gg)

  grid<-plot_grid(plotlist=plots,
                  ncol=2,nrow=2,
                  labels=c("A","B","C","D"),
                  rel_widths=c(1,1),
                  rel_heights=c(1,1),
                  label_size=16)

  out_file<-path(out_dir,out_name)
  ggsave(out_file,grid,width=width,height=height,dpi=dpi,bg="white")
  out_file
}

written<-save_grid_2x2(img_dir=img_dir,out_dir=out_dir)
if(!is.na(written))message("Wrote: ",written)
```

## Compare cdhit trees colored by cluster 97,98,99 for HA only
```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(magick)
library(fs)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# inputs
base_dir<-"../2026-01-23_g1_trees_out/"
out_dir<-"plot_out"
dir_create(out_dir)

seg<-"HA"
cutoffs<-seq(97,99,by=1)

# helper: read TIFF -> ggplot object (optional crop top & bottom)
img_to_gg<-function(img_path,crop_frac=0){
  img<-magick::image_read(img_path)
  info<-magick::image_info(img)
  w<-info$width[1]
  h<-info$height[1]

  if(!is.null(crop_frac) && crop_frac>0){
    crop_px<-round(h*crop_frac)
    new_h<-h-(2*crop_px)
    geom<-paste0(w,"x",new_h,"+0+",crop_px)
    img<-magick::image_crop(img,geom)
  }

  ggdraw()+draw_image(as.raster(img),x=0,y=0,width=1,height=1)+theme_void()
}

# build expected paths for HA TipColor tiffs
expected_paths<-function(base_dir,seg,cutoffs){
  # example file name:"../2026-01-23_g1_trees_out/HA_cdhit97_TipColor.tiff"
  map_chr(cutoffs,~path(base_dir,paste0(seg,"_cdhit",.x,"_TipColor.tiff")))
}

# make labels like: A) 97%, ...
panel_labels<-function(cutoffs){
  letters3<-LETTERS[seq_along(cutoffs)]
  paste0(letters3,") ",
         formatC(cutoffs,format="f",digits=0),
         "%")
}

save_ha_tree_row<-function(base_dir,out_dir,seg="HA",cutoffs=seq(97,99,1),
                           width=6,height=4.2,dpi=300,
                           out_name="cdhit_eval_trees_HA_composite.png"){

  paths<-expected_paths(base_dir,seg,cutoffs)
  missing<-paths[!file_exists(paths)]
  if(length(missing)>0){
    message("Missing files:\n",paste(missing,collapse="\n"))
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  plots<-map(paths,img_to_gg)

  grid<-plot_grid(plotlist=plots,
                  ncol=length(plots),
                  labels=panel_labels(cutoffs),
                  label_size=14,
                  label_x=0.02,
                  label_y=0.98,
                  hjust=0,
                  vjust=1)

  out_file<-path(out_dir,out_name)
  ggsave(out_file,grid,width=width,height=height,dpi=dpi,bg="white")
  out_file
}

written<-save_ha_tree_row(base_dir=base_dir,out_dir=out_dir,seg=seg,cutoffs=cutoffs)
if(!is.na(written))message("Wrote: ",written)
```

## Compare cdhit trees colored by cluster 97,98,99 for all 8 segments
```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(magick)
library(fs)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# inputs
base_dir<-"../2026-01-23_g1_trees_out/"
out_dir<-"plot_out"
dir_create(out_dir)

segs<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA_seg","M","NS") # NA segment's TipColor tiffs are saved as "NA_seg" (avoids literal NA)
cutoffs<-seq(97,99,by=1)

# helper: read TIFF -> ggplot object (optional crop top & bottom)
img_to_gg<-function(img_path,crop_frac=0){
  img<-magick::image_read(img_path)
  info<-magick::image_info(img)
  w<-info$width[1]
  h<-info$height[1]

  if(!is.null(crop_frac) && crop_frac>0){
    crop_px<-round(h*crop_frac)
    new_h<-h-(2*crop_px)
    geom<-paste0(w,"x",new_h,"+0+",crop_px)
    img<-magick::image_crop(img,geom)
  }

  ggdraw()+draw_image(as.raster(img),x=0,y=0,width=1,height=1)+theme_void()
}

# build expected paths for TipColor tiffs
expected_paths<-function(base_dir,seg,cutoffs){
  # example file name:"../2026-01-23_g1_trees_out/HA_cdhit97_TipColor.tiff"
  map_chr(cutoffs,~path(base_dir,paste0(seg,"_cdhit",.x,"_TipColor.tiff")))
}

# make labels like: A) 97%, ...
panel_labels<-function(cutoffs){
  letters3<-LETTERS[seq_along(cutoffs)]
  paste0(letters3,") ",
         formatC(cutoffs,format="f",digits=0),
         "%")
}

save_tree_row<-function(base_dir,out_dir,seg="HA",cutoffs=seq(97,99,1),
                        width=6,height=4.2,dpi=300){

  paths<-expected_paths(base_dir,seg,cutoffs)
  missing<-paths[!file_exists(paths)]
  if(length(missing)>0){
    message(seg," missing files:\n",paste(missing,collapse="\n"))
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  plots<-map(paths,img_to_gg)

  grid<-plot_grid(plotlist=plots,
                  ncol=length(plots),
                  labels=panel_labels(cutoffs),
                  label_size=14,
                  label_x=0.02,
                  label_y=0.98,
                  hjust=0,
                  vjust=1)

  out_name<-paste0("cdhit_eval_trees_",seg,"_composite.png")
  out_file<-path(out_dir,out_name)
  ggsave(out_file,grid,width=width,height=height,dpi=dpi,bg="white")
  out_file
}

written<-map_chr(segs,~save_tree_row(base_dir=base_dir,out_dir=out_dir,seg=.x,cutoffs=cutoffs))

ok<-written[!is.na(written)]
bad<-segs[is.na(written)]

if(length(ok)>0)message("Wrote:\n",paste(ok,collapse="\n"))
if(length(bad)>0)message("Skipped (missing): ",paste(bad,collapse=", "))
```

## figure composite of trees at best cutoff 98%, all segments 
```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(magick)
library(fs)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# inputs
base_dir<-"../2026-01-23_g1_trees_out/"
out_dir<-"plot_out"
dir_create(out_dir)

segs<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA_seg","M","NS")
cutoff<-98

# helper: read TIFF -> ggplot object (optional crop top & bottom)
img_to_gg<-function(img_path,crop_frac=0){
  img<-magick::image_read(img_path)
  info<-magick::image_info(img)
  w<-info$width[1]
  h<-info$height[1]

  if(!is.null(crop_frac) && crop_frac>0){
    crop_px<-round(h*crop_frac)
    new_h<-h-(2*crop_px)
    geom<-paste0(w,"x",new_h,"+0+",crop_px)
    img<-magick::image_crop(img,geom)
  }

  ggdraw()+draw_image(as.raster(img),x=0,y=0,width=1,height=1)+theme_void()
}

# fixed filenames for one cutoff across segments
expected_paths<-function(base_dir,segs,cutoff){
  # example file name:"../2026-01-23_g1_trees_out/HA_cdhit98_TipColor.tiff"
  map_chr(segs,~path(base_dir,paste0(.x,"_cdhit",cutoff,"_TipColor.tiff")))
}

# build combined grid
save_allsegs_onecutoff<-function(base_dir,out_dir,segs,cutoff,
                                 width=10,height=9,dpi=300){

  paths<-expected_paths(base_dir,segs,cutoff)
  missing<-segs[!file_exists(paths)]
  if(length(missing)>0){
    message("Missing segments: ",paste(missing,collapse=", "))
    message("Missing files:\n",paste(paths[!file_exists(paths)],collapse="\n"))
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  plots<-map(paths,img_to_gg)

  grid<-plot_grid(plotlist=plots,
                  ncol=4,nrow=2,
                  labels=NA)

  out_name<-paste0("cdhit",cutoff,"_trees_allsegs_comp.png")
  out_file<-path(out_dir,out_name)

  ggsave(out_file,grid,width=width,height=height,dpi=dpi,bg="white")
  out_file
}

written<-save_allsegs_onecutoff(base_dir=base_dir,out_dir=out_dir,segs=segs,cutoff=cutoff)
if(!is.na(written))message("Wrote: ",written)
```

## CLUSTER SIZE DISTRIB ACROSS SEGS for the best cutoff 98% only
```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(magick)
library(fs)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# inputs
img_dir<-"../2026-07-01_g1_eval_out"
out_dir<-"plot_out"
dir_create(out_dir)

segs<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA","M","NS")
cutoff<-98

# helper
img_to_gg<-function(img_path){
  img<-magick::image_read(img_path)
  ggdraw()+draw_image(as.raster(img),x=0,y=0,width=1,height=1)+theme_void()
}

# fixed filenames
expected_paths<-function(img_dir,segs,cutoff){
  # example file name:"../2026-07-01_g1_eval_out/logclustsize_HA_98_g1.tiff"
  map_chr(segs,~path(img_dir,paste0("logclustsize_",.x,"_",cutoff,"_g1.tiff")))
}

# build combined grid
save_grid<-function(img_dir,out_dir,segs,cutoff,
                    width=8,height=3,dpi=300){

  paths<-expected_paths(img_dir,segs,cutoff)
  missing<-segs[!file_exists(paths)]
  if(length(missing)>0){
    message("Missing segments: ",paste(missing,collapse=", "))
    message("Missing files:\n",paste(paths[!file_exists(paths)],collapse="\n"))
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  plots<-map(paths,img_to_gg)

  grid<-plot_grid(plotlist=plots,
                  ncol=4,nrow=2,
                  labels=NA)

  out_name<-paste0("cdhit",cutoff,"_logclustsize_allsegs_comp.png")
  out_file<-path(out_dir,out_name)

  ggsave(out_file,grid,width=width,height=height,dpi=dpi,bg="white")
  out_file
}

written<-save_grid(img_dir=img_dir,out_dir=out_dir,segs=segs,cutoff=cutoff)
if(!is.na(written))message("Wrote: ",written)
```

## CDHIT patristic distance dsitrib within genetic clusters
```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(magick)
library(fs)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# inputs
img_dir<-"../2026-08-20_g1_trees_out/"
out_dir<-"plot_out"
dir_create(out_dir)

segs<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA","M","NS")

# helper
img_to_gg<-function(img_path){
  img<-magick::image_read(img_path)
  ggdraw()+draw_image(as.raster(img),x=0,y=0,width=1,height=1)+theme_void()
}

# fixed filenames
files<-paste0(segs,"_patdist_withinclades.tiff")
paths<-path(img_dir,files)

if(any(!file_exists(paths))){
  message("Missing:\n",paste(paths[!file_exists(paths)],collapse="\n"))
}else{

  plots<-map(paths,img_to_gg)

  grid<-plot_grid(plotlist=plots,
                  ncol=4,nrow=2,
                  labels=NA)

  out_name<-"allsegs_patdist_withinCDHIT_comp.png"
  out_file<-path(out_dir,out_name)

  ggsave(out_file,grid,width=8,height=3.5,dpi=600,bg="white")
  message("Wrote: ",out_file)
}
```
